summary.text: Spaceless Tunnel is a method Wei Ling Yang names when Central Continent's three Immortal Gu Houses still have half the journey left through immemorial black heaven.

claims.text: After a star cloud storm and a sky chief beast ambush, the three Immortal Gu Houses are heavily damaged, Myriad Tidal Dragon is unconscious, and Wei Ling Yang and Bi Chen Tian have each spent more than half their immortal essence. Half the journey remains. Wei Ling Yang names this method. Bi Chen Tian says that is the only way to cross half of the distance. Fairy Zi Wei had already prepared it among other plans. From Luck Suppression Heavenly Palace, South Desolation Immortal sees the Central Continent Gu Immortals vanish all of a sudden.

Canary Pavilion, Edge Link Camp, and Wind Sweeping Building move inside a huge blue tunnel. Rainbow colored threads extend forward along the path and line the walls. Bu Zhen Zi names the phenomenon, then says it is a unique immortal killer move created by Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable.

Giant Sun immortal zombie identifies the vanishing as this move, and denies that Central Continent possesses it. They are using the spaceless tunnel left behind by Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable. It is a space path immortal killer move. Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable had traveled almost every area in the five regions and two heavens, felt that a person was too small and the Gu Master world too big, and created the move to shorten traveling distance and hasten exploration. He has gone missing, but portions left in the five regions and two heavens still exist and seem able to last forever. When Central Continent’s Gu Immortals found this tunnel, they could use a corresponding method and shorten their travel distance. Giant Sun immortal zombie cannot find where it leads, and says they only need to wait for the travelers to reappear.

The three houses stay inside until Myriad Tidal Dragon wakes, then take the final bit of distance. A giant ghost face appears, blocks the entire tunnel, and roars without sound. The tunnel collapses. Dao mark fragments fly everywhere, and a space crack spreads like a spider web. The shortcut they were using is a fatal trap. Three hundred thousand years ago, when Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable traveled in black heaven, he left this tunnel behind.

Fang Yuan groups it with divine concealment and ghostly concealment as a lasting killer move. It was used in various places of the five regions and two heavens to shorten travel distance, and the three hundred thousand year old move was still active, but with the fusion of two heavens it should already have been mostly destroyed.
